question: In October 2024, DRDO developed the 'VSHORADS' system. What is it used for?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Short-range air defence**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **VSHORADS (Very Short Range Air Defence System)** is an indigenously developed man-portable air defence system by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** of India. 
• It is specifically designed to provide **short-range air defence** capabilities against aerial threats such as **fighter aircraft, helicopters, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs)**, and other low-flying platforms. 
• The system uses **infrared (IR) homing technology** to track and engage targets with high accuracy, ensuring effective defence in diverse environments. 
• **VSHORADS** is lightweight and portable, making it suitable for deployment in **difficult terrains** such as mountainous regions and areas with limited infrastructure. 
• The development aligns with the **‘Atmanirbhar Bharat’ (Self-reliant India)** initiative, showcasing India’s growing capability in producing advanced defence systems indigenously. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Features of the VSHORADS system:** 
• The system is equipped with a **dual-band infrared seeker**, making it effective in both day and night conditions. 
• It is designed to operate in **adverse weather conditions** and counter modern aerial threats with **stealth and jamming capabilities**. 
• The missile is powered by a **solid rocket motor** and can engage targets at close range with high precision. 
• **Development and testing:** 
• The **DRDO successfully tested the VSHORADS missile** in September 2022, demonstrating its effectiveness in neutralizing aerial targets. 
• The system has been extensively tested for **mobility, launch capabilities, and target acquisition** in various terrains, including high-altitude regions. 
• **Applications:** 
• The VSHORADS system is primarily aimed at defending **critical military and civilian infrastructure** such as airbases, radar installations, and command centres from aerial threats. 
• It can be deployed with **infantry units** to provide immediate air defence support in combat zones. 
• **Global Context:** 
• Similar systems include the **FIM-92 Stinger** (USA) and **9K38 Igla** (Russia), highlighting the importance of short-range air defence systems in modern warfare. 
• The development of VSHORADS places India among the few nations capable of indigenously producing advanced **man-portable air defence systems**. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **DRDO:** The **Defence Research and Development Organisation** is India’s premier R&D organization under the **Ministry of Defence**, responsible for developing advanced defence technologies. 
• **‘Atmanirbhar Bharat’ Initiative:** This initiative aims to make India self-reliant in defence manufacturing by promoting indigenous technologies and reducing dependence on foreign imports. 
• **Significance of Air Defence Systems:** 
• Air defence systems play a critical role in protecting a nation’s **sovereignty and strategic assets**. 
• They provide a **layered defence mechanism** against a wide range of aerial threats, enhancing national security.
